full_prompt_en: A square oil painting shows an adult man seated behind a table in a dark interior. He looks outward with a mild, direct expression. Wavy brown hair frames a pale face with rosy cheeks, narrow eyes, and a thin upturned mustache. A bright white collar and gathered cuffs emerge from a loose, almost black satin jacket. His right hand works near a heap of fresh green leafy herbs across the table's front center; his left hand rests on the vegetation. The tabletop is crowded but carefully arranged. At left are a clear bottle and a shallow bowl. Near the center lie pale folded papers partly tucked under the herbs. At right stand small glass jars, an amber round vessel, dried bulbs or roots, and other still-life items. A small arrangement of pale flowers and fruit catches faint light behind his right shoulder. The far room remains nearly black, so the man and objects seem to emerge slowly from darkness. Warm side lighting strikes the face, hands, white linen, glass rims, amber jar, and green leaves. The coat's dark folds retain delicate reflected highlights, suggesting a smooth heavy fabric. Brushwork is controlled across the face but looser in the herbs and glass reflections. The composition forms a triangle from head to two hands and broad pile of leaves; tabletop objects extend the horizontal base. There is no clear window or architectural setting. The visible paper marks are not legible as writing, and no caption appears. The painting has an intimate, worldly calm: the figure's presence shares attention with the textures and colors of plants, cloth, paper, and translucent vessels.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形油画描绘一位成年男子坐在暗室的桌后，以温和直接的神情向外看。波浪棕发框着浅色脸，脸颊微红，眼睛细窄，嘴上有向上卷的薄胡须。明亮白衣领和收拢袖口从几乎黑色的宽松缎面外套中露出。他的右手在桌前中央一堆新鲜绿叶草药旁忙碌，左手搁在叶子上。桌面拥挤，却安排仔细。左边有透明瓶和浅碗，中央附近浅色折纸部分塞在草药下。右边立着小玻璃罐、琥珀圆罐、干燥球根或根茎及其他静物。右肩后有浅色花和果实在弱光中显出。远处房间几乎全黑，所以男子和物件仿佛慢慢从暗中浮现。暖侧光落在脸、手、白布、玻璃边、琥珀罐及绿叶上。外套深褶留有微弱反光，暗示平滑厚布。脸部笔触受控，草药与玻璃反光较松。头到双手和宽阔叶堆形成三角构图，桌面物件延伸其水平底边。没有清楚窗户或建筑场所。纸面痕迹无法读作文字，也没有标题。绘画具有亲近、世俗的平静：人物存在与植物、衣料、纸及透明器皿的肌理和颜色共同获得注意力。
style_prompt_en: The dark domestic oil-painting treatment lets forms emerge from a nearly black ground through selective warm illumination. Pale faces or linenlike areas, small glass glints, leafy green masses, and amber vessels form islands of light amid deep brown and charcoal. Smooth fabriclike folds are modeled with thin reflected highlights, while organic textures receive freer small strokes. A triangular focal structure rests on a broad tabletop base crowded with still-life details. Contours soften as they approach the dark surroundings; only the brightest hands, rims, and edges are crisp. The palette is restrained and natural, rich in umber, olive, cream, muted red, and honey amber. The finish is tactile, intimate, and quietly observational, balancing human presence with the material interest of ordinary objects.
style_prompt_zh: 深暗家庭室内油画处理使形体借选择性暖光从近黑底子中浮出。浅面或白布般区域、小玻璃闪点、绿叶团块和琥珀容器在深褐与炭灰中形成光岛。平滑织物般褶皱由细微反光造型，有机肌理由更自由的小笔触描绘。三角焦点结构压在摆满静物细节的宽桌面底座上。轮廓接近暗处时柔化；最亮的手、器皿边和物件缘才清脆。色盘克制自然，充满赭褐、橄榄、奶油、低饱和红与蜂蜜琥珀。完成度可触、亲近而安静观察，在人物存在与普通物件的材料趣味间平衡。
theme_en: A seated man with a thin mustache handles herbs at a table of glassware in a dark oil-painted room
theme_zh: 深暗油画室内，细胡须男子坐在摆着玻璃器皿的桌前整理草药
name: Nicolaes Maes
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
